domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, approval/rejection, and cancellation. References the employee, the leave type/policy, and the approving/rejecting/cancelling actor.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — initial state; request is being prepared by the employee; not yet visible to managers
SUBMITTED — employee has submitted for review; visible to the manager; awaiting action
APPROVED — manager (or system for auto-approve policies) has approved; balance has been deducted; terminal state
REJECTED — manager has rejected with a reason; no balance impact; terminal state
CANCELLED — employee or admin has cancelled the request; if previously APPROVED, balance is restored; terminal state

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of all possible lifecycle states for a LeaveRequest. Drives state-transition validation and access control decisions.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year. Deducted on approval; restored on cancellation of an approved request.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is available for use; employee can submit leave requests against it
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays is zero; no further leave of this type can be taken this fiscal year
FROZEN — balance is temporarily unavailable (e.g., during investigation or payroll hold); no new requests accepted

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a category of leave. Each policy governs one LeaveType. Determines whether manager approval is required, how many days are entitled, accrual behavior, notice requirements, and whether negative balances are permitted.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect; employees can request leave under this policy
INACTIVE — policy is disabled; no new requests accepted; existing approved leave is unaffected
ARCHIVED — policy has been retired; historical reference only

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each LeavePolicy maps to exactly one LeaveType. Drives policy lookup and balance segregation.

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. The employee is the actor who applies for leave and the subject whose balances are tracked. The managerId field establishes the approval hierarchy.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed; eligible for leave
INACTIVE — employee is on extended leave or suspension; leave requests may be restricted
TERMINATED — employment has ended; no leave requests allowed; balances are frozen for audit

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Represents a notification triggered by leave lifecycle events. Sent to employees (on approval/rejection/cancellation of their request), managers (on new submission from their report), and when balances reach thresholds.
lifecycle_states: PENDING — notification has been created but not yet delivered
SENT — notification has been delivered to the recipient
READ — recipient has acknowledged/read the notification
ARCHIVED — notification is no longer shown in the active inbox

business_rules: BR-001 — Employee eligibility: Only employees with employmentStatus ACTIVE may submit a leave request. INACTIVE employees may have restricted submission (configurable per policy). TERMINATED employees cannot submit any leave request.

BR-002 — Date validity: startDate must be on or before endDate. startDate must not be in the past at the time of submission (DRAFT → SUBMITTED transition). Both dates must be within the same fiscal year as the balance being drawn from.

BR-003 — Balance sufficiency: On SUBMITTED → APPROVED transition, the system must verify that remainingDays >= requestedDays for the applicable LeaveBalance. If allowNegativeBalance is false on the policy and the balance is insufficient, the approval must be rejected. If allowNegativeBalance is true, the balance may go negative up to the policy's configured limit.

BR-004 — Balance deduction: On APPROVED, the system deducts the requested number of days from the employee's LeaveBalance.usedDays is incremented and remainingDays is decremented by the number of working days in the date range (not calendar days).

BR-006 — Manager approval: When requiresManagerApproval is true on the LeavePolicy, only the employee's manager (Employee.managerId) or an admin may transition the request from SUBMITTED to APPROVED or REJECTED. When requiresManagerApproval is false, the system auto-approves on submission (DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED in a single atomic operation).

BR-005 — Balance restoration on cancellation: When an APPROVED LeaveRequest transitions to CANCELLED, the previously deducted days are restored to the LeaveBalance. usedDays is decremented and remainingDays is incremented by the same number of working days. If the request was not yet APPROVED (DRAFT or SUBMITTED), cancellation has no balance impact.

BR-007 — Minimum notice: When minimumNoticeDays is set on the LeavePolicy, the startDate must be at least minimumNoticeDays calendar days after the submission date. This is enforced on the DRAFT → SUBMITTED transition. Emergency leave (LeaveType.EMERGENCY) bypasses this rule.

BR-008 — Maximum consecutive days: When maxConsecutiveDays is set on the LeavePolicy, the requested date range must not exceed maxConsecutiveDays working days. Enforced on DRAFT → SUBMITTED transition.

BR-010 — State transition authorization: DRAFT → SUBMITTED: only the owning employee. SUBMITTED → APPROVED: only the employee's manager or an admin. SUBMITTED → REJECTED: only the employee's manager or an admin, and rejectionReason is required. Any non-terminal state → CANCELLED: the owning employee or an admin. APPROVED → CANCELLED: the owning employee or an admin (triggers BR-005). No transitions out of APPROVED, REJECTED, or CANCELLED (terminal states).

BR-009 — Overlapping requests: An employee cannot have two LeaveRequests with overlapping date ranges in SUBMITTED or APPROVED status for the same LeaveType. Overlap detection uses working days, not calendar days. DRAFT and REJECTED requests are excluded from overlap checks.

BR-011 — Audit trail: Every state transition on a LeaveRequest (DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED, SUBMITTED→REJECTED, *→CANCELLED) and every mutation of a LeaveBalance (deduction on approval, restoration on cancellation) must produce an AuditRecord capturing the old state, new state, actor, and timestamp (GP-002).

BR-012 — Fiscal year alignment: LeaveBalance is scoped to a fiscalYear. A LeaveRequest's startDate determines which fiscal year's balance is used. If a request spans two fiscal years, it must be split or rejected at submission time — cross-fiscal-year requests are not permitted.
domain_notes:
Lifecycle states introduced in this feature:

**LeaveRequest**: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED). DRAFT and SUBMITTED can also transition directly to CANCELLED. APPROVED, REJECTED, and CANCELLED are terminal states.

**LeaveBalance**: ACTIVE → EXHAUSTED (when remainingDays reaches 0). ACTIVE → FROZEN (administrative hold). FROZEN → ACTIVE (release). EXHAUSTED → ACTIVE (when balance is restored or new fiscal year begins).

**LeavePolicy**: ACTIVE → INACTIVE (disabled by admin). INACTIVE → ACTIVE (re-enabled). ACTIVE/INACTIVE → ARCHIVED (retired permanently).

**Employee**: ACTIVE → INACTIVE (extended leave/suspension). INACTIVE → ACTIVE (return). ACTIVE/INACTIVE → TERMINATED (employment ended). TERMINATED is terminal.

**Notification**: PENDING → SENT → READ → ARCHIVED. Standard delivery lifecycle.

Key cross-entity relationships:
- LeaveRequest references Employee (employeeId, approvedBy, rejectedBy, cancelledBy) and LeavePolicy (leaveTypeId)
- LeaveBalance references Employee (employeeId) and LeavePolicy (policyId)
- Employee.managerId establishes the approval hierarchy for BR-006
- LeavePolicy.leaveType drives which LeaveBalance is drawn from
- Notification.relatedEntityId links back to LeaveRequest or LeaveBalance
